subject: Ir/IrOx~SO3H
source_sentence: The iR-corrected linear sweep voltammetry (LSV) curves (Fig. S6a ) demonstrated the better OER activity of Ir/IrO x ~ SO 3 H, which required an overpotential of 233 mV to achieve a current density of 10 mA cm −2 , lower than that of commercial Ir/IrO x (255 mV).
